title: Finite-cover presentation and points of an inverse limit of qcqs etale topoi
statement: Let $I$ be a small nonempty cofiltered category in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], and let $(Y_i)_{i\in I}$ be a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with quasi-compact quasi-separated transition morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For each $i$ let $\mathcal C_i$ be a small equivalent version of the category of quasi-compact quasi-separated etale $Y_i$-schemes, equipped with finite jointly surjective covering families [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Transition functors are scheme-theoretic pullback, with its canonical composition isomorphisms. After replacing this system by an equivalent strict system, form the colimit site $\mathcal C=\varinjlim_i\mathcal C_i$ with the finite coverings coming from stages [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]. Then $\mathcal C$ has finite limits, its terminal object is the image of every $Y_i$, and $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ with its projection geometric morphisms $p_i$ is a $2$-categorical inverse limit of the small etale topoi $(Y_i)_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-topos, def-trf-geometric-morphism]. A compatible family of geometric points of the $Y_i$, including isomorphisms between the pulled-back topos points satisfying the cocycle condition, determines a point of $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$, and there is a set of such points which is conservative: a morphism of sheaves is an isomorphism if its inverse images at all points of this set are bijections. Here a geometric point is a morphism from the spectrum of a separably closed field [def-weil-geometric-point]. The construction and projection inverse images are invariant, up to their canonical equivalences, under cofinal reindexing and compatible isomorphisms of the diagrams of schemes. No inverse limit scheme or affineness of transition morphisms is assumed.

source.place: Tags 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), 0A35 (lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit), 00YQ (proposition-criterion-points); finite-cover presentation and geometric-point interpretation specialized to qcqs etale sites. Also ILO XX 4.4, printed p.373, the paragraph defining the projective-limit etale topos.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-qcqs-etale-limit-presentation-exists] to obtain P, and [lem-per-qcqs-etale-presentation-topos-limit] to obtain its IsToposLimit property. The categories of sets in the containing universe form a Grothendieck topos: use sheaves for the bottom topology on the discrete singleton, whose presheaf category is equivalent to sets. The essential-surjectivity conjunct of IsToposLimit therefore factors every geometric-point cone through P.

A P.cover covering presieve is the image of a finite stage covering by P.cover_iff and P.stageCover_iff; its uncurried set of arrows is contained in the finite image of that stage presieve. Index a covering presieve by its distinct arrows to obtain a finite family. The finite composition axiom gives bind composition with one chosen inner cover per distinct outer arrow, and finite base change gives pullbacks of the finite representative family. Repeated members in an arbitrary presentation produce the same pullback presieve, proving IsSiteForCoverings. Thus the finite-refinement hypothesis of [lem-trf-finitary-site-enough-points] holds. Apply it with the finite limits P.finiteLimits to obtain points t that jointly detect isomorphisms. Compose each point with each projection using [def-trf-geometric-morphism], and apply [lem-trf-etale-topos-points-geometric]. Its algebraically closed field is separably closed and its inverse image is the required composite, so the same points retain conservativity.

For r, D' and epsilon as in the last clause, transport compactness and quasi-separatedness of each D(r(j)) through epsilon_j. Every D' transition is qcqs since its source and target are qcqs. Apply [lem-per-qcqs-etale-limit-presentation-exists] to D' for nonemptiness. For each supplied P', [lem-per-qcqs-etale-presentation-comparison] gives its canonical comparison with P. Assemble the four conjuncts with the witness P.

proof_origin.place: Lean assembly of original Steps 1-7. Steps 1-3, 4-5, and 7 are the three named component obligations. Step 6, the finite site axioms and refinements, the sets-topos witness, and the reindexed existence argument are proved in the item module. ILO XX 4.4, printed p.373.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q144-7c8d2ccf9 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS, no fixes. I read the item, both new nodes, every cited statement and each source at the cited place: ILO XX 4.4 printed p.373 (the projective-limit étale topos, Deligne enough points, geometric points with a separable closure) and Stacks 00X6, 09YL, 0A35, 03A1, 00YQ, 04HU, 04E7, 04AX, 004A. Statement and stmt_deps are unchanged from the unproved seed. All seven steps check out. Step 1: the qcqs étale category is closed under fibre products, and the finite affine refinement plus the comparison lemma give Sh(T_et). Step 2: strictification over I^op with H empty. Step 3: finite limits by the stagewise Hom calculation, using that filtered colimits commute with finite limits. Steps 4-5: R_{h#∘u_i}=p_{i*}, so the extension is p_i^{-1}; the pseudococone gluing and the lex-cover equivalence give the 2-categorical limit including 2-cells. Step 6: enough points and the geometric-point classification, with the r_t identified with the family-determined points by Step 5 full faithfulness. Step 7: final reindexing and objectwise equivalences. New node lex-cover-functor-extension is true: sieves all of whose pullbacks go to epimorphic families form a topology, R_A is a sheaf, and L_A over elements is left adjoint to R_A; it does not duplicate left-exact-site-inverse-image-tensor (site to site, no equivalence) or topos-site-presentation. New node filtered-category-pseudococones is true: for parallel arrows equalized later, the cocycle forces θ_a=θ_a' on the common object; the final-reindexing and objectwise-equivalence clauses also hold. It is not a duplicate of the directed filtered-two-colimit nodes or coherent-pair-functor-descent. Neither new node restates the parent. Batch-5 flags, all three accepted: def-trf-geometric-morphism is a general definition. lem-trf-finitary-site-enough-points (Deligne) and lem-trf-etale-topos-points-geometric are general topos and étale results that neither the trace-formula nor the PD statement gives. Their closures contain no trace-formula or PD statement, no sk-thm/nt- node and no sec-poincare-duality node, both are already cited by non-trf nodes, and here they are not used as steps of proving the trace formula. The 13 tool_uses are generic and accepted. Notes: the seeded statement's gloss 'separably closed [def-weil-geometric-point]' is looser than the definition (algebraically closed), but the proof works for either reading. Step 1 is marked elementary while listing uses (cosmetic).

lean.statement: theorem qcqs_etale_topos_inverse_limit (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), QuasiCompact (D.map a)] [∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), QuasiSeparated (D.map a)] : ∃ P : QcqsEtaleLimit.Presentation D, QcqsEtaleLimit.IsToposLimit P.projections ∧ (∀ q : QcqsEtaleLimit.GeometricPointCone D, Nonempty (QcqsEtaleLimit.Factorization P.projections q.cone)) ∧ (∃ (T : Type (u + 1)) (points : T → GeometricMorphism (Type (u + 1)) (Sheaf P.cover.toGrothendieck (Type (u + 1)))), (∀ (t : T) (i : I), ∃ (Ω : Type u) (_ : Field Ω) (_ : IsSepClosed Ω) (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.obj i), Nonempty ((P.projections.projection i).inverse ⋙ (points t).inverse ≅ (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := Type (u + 1)))) ∧ ∀ {F G : Sheaf P.cover.toGrothendieck (Type (u + 1))} (a : F ⟶ G), (∀ t : T, Function.Bijective ((points t).inverse.map a)) → IsIso a) ∧ (∀ (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (r : J ⥤ I) [r.Initial] (D' : J ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (ε : D' ≅ r ⋙ D), Nonempty (QcqsEtaleLimit.Presentation D') ∧ ∀ P' : QcqsEtaleLimit.Presentation D', ∃ c : QcqsEtaleLimit.Comparison P.projections P'.projections r ε, c.IsCanonical)

Universes match etaleToposPoint_isGeometric and finitarySite_enoughPoints. Statements verbatim; docstrings with all 7 proof steps; only sorry is the theorem proof; no duplicate found.
